/bin/bash -lc 'rg -n "export declare const TextInput|export declare const Select|gap.*Space" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/*/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/layout/Flex/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40'

/bin/bash -lc "node <<'NODE'
const fs = require('fs');
const path = 'src/App.tsx';
let content = fs.readFileSync(path, 'utf8');
content = content
  .replace(/\\n  Input,/, '')
  .replace(/\\n  Toaster,/, '')
  .replace(/import \\{\\n  Avatar,/, 'import {\\n  Avatar,')
  .replace(/\\n  TextInput,/, '\\n  TextInput,')
  .replace(/gap=\"s\"/g, 'gap={2}')
  .replace(/gap=\"m\"/g, 'gap={4}')
  .replace(/gap=\"l\"/g, 'gap={5}')
  .replace(/<Input\\b/g, '<TextInput')
  .replace(/<TextInput\\n              value=\\{settings\\.name\\}/, '<TextInput\\n              value={settings.name}');
fs.writeFileSync(path, content);
NODE
